summary: __thiscall that tests an AABB's 8 corner vertices (starting at this+0x24, 3 floats per corner) against 6 frustum planes read from a2+0x104 onward (4 floats each). Clears the lower 4 bits of the visibility flag word this+0x4, then evaluates each plane: for each of the 8 corners it checks the signed plane distance and accumulates a per-plane bitmask v5. If all 8 corners are outside one plane (v5 == 255) the object is fully culled and bit 1 is set; if any corner is outside any plane (v5 != 0) bit 2 is set (partial); if all corners of all 6 planes pass, bit 0 is set (fully visible). Always returns 0. Called by sub_556E70 (0x00556E70), a scene-culling path.

local_names.this: candidate object whose visibility flags (this+0x4) and AABB corners (this+0x24) are tested
local_names.a2: frustum source: 6 planes, each 4 floats (nx, ny, nz, d), starting at a2+260
local_names.v3: flag word with lower 4 bits masked off before testing
local_names.v5: per-plane bitmask of corners outside the plane; 255 means all 8 outside
local_names.v6: corner index 0..7, also selects the bit shifted into v5
local_names.v7: running pointer over the 8 corners (3 floats per corner)
local_names.i: running pointer over the 4-float plane rows in a2

operations.description: Clear the lower 4 bits of the flag word at this+0x4 (v3 = this[1] & 0xFFFFFFF0) and store v3 back to this+0x4.
Outer loop over the 6 frustum planes, starting at a2+260 and advancing 4 floats per plane; also tracks plane count v10, breaking the search once all 6 planes have passed.
Inner loop over the 8 AABB corners starting at this+9 (this+0x24), advancing 3 floats per corner.
Per corner, evaluate the signed plane distance -dot(plane_n, corner) - plane_d against i[1]; if it exceeds i[1] (outside the plane), set the corner's bit in v5 (v5 |= 1 << v6).
If v5 != 0 for the current plane (at least one corner outside), break out of the plane loop.
If all 6 planes passed with every corner inside (v5 == 0 each time), write this+0x4 = v3 | 1 (fully visible) and return 0.
On the plane where the loop broke: if v5 == 255 (all 8 corners outside that plane) the object is fully culled; otherwise it is partially intersecting.
Write this+0x4 = v3 | 2 (fully culled) when v5 == 255, or this+0x4 = v3 | 4 (partial/intersecting) otherwise.
Return 0 on both the visible and culled/partial paths.
This function is called by sub_556E70 (0x00556E70) as part of a scene-culling traversal.
